content.text: {"verdicts":[{"check":"quote_supports_claim","artifact":"recap_email","target":"against your 307 plates a day on a busy day","passed":false,"severity":"high","finding":"Ingrid said about 300 plates a day, not 307; the number was altered and the cited U043 excerpt contradicts the email body.","utterance_ids":["U043","U044"]},{"check":"quote_supports_claim","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Marcus will add the plate ID to the curve fit flag","passed":false,"severity":"low","finding":"The cited excerpt for U010 reads 'We can add...' but the transcript says 'We can add the plate ID to the flag so they can see if it's always the same plate' with different wording ('We can' matches), yet the excerpt text 'We can add the plate ID to the flag so they can see if it's always the same plate.' is accurate to U010 and supports the claim; however the excerpt as written drops nothing, so only the lack of a date is an issue, not the quote.","utterance_ids":["U010","U011"]},{"check":"commitment_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"the DPA is attached for your legal team","passed":false,"severity":"medium","finding":"Sam said he could send the standard DPA with the recap, which is a commitment to send it; the email states it as attached, which is only accurate if the file is actually attached, so verify before sending.","utterance_ids":["U041","U042"]},{"check":"email_promises_uncommitted","artifact":"recap_email","target":"If a short hosting call would help once the memo is in hand, tell us what works for you.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Offers a call without pushing; Ingrid said maybe and wants to settle internally first, so this matches the customer-owned process.","utterance_ids":["U050","U051"]},{"check":"email_promises_uncommitted","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Marcus will add the plate ID to the curve fit flag and confirm the EU only support access wording with our compliance team. We have not set dates for these yet.","passed":false,"severity":"medium","finding":"Both items were committed by Marcus in the call, but the email gives no owner dates and tells the customer none exist, which leaves the commitments open and violates the dated-commitment practice.","utterance_ids":["U010","U021","U022"]},{"check":"buying_signal_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Results in about two minutes supports Ingrid's goal of scientists deciding the next run the same afternoon, which she believes could take a week or more out of each screening campaign.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Uses Ingrid's own framing with her hedge 'we think we could', and does not present it as a decision.","utterance_ids":["U004","U007"]},{"check":"superseded_feature_as_current","artifact":"recap_email","target":"We can support either, and the DPA is attached for your legal team.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"No superseded feature is presented; the EU region and support-access statements match RC-14 and the email keeps the caveat that wording is to be confirmed.","utterance_ids":["U019","U021","U029"]},{"check":"generic_step","artifact":"recap_email","target":"If a short hosting call would help once the memo is in hand, tell us what works for you.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The offer is tied to the memo and the hosting disagreement and respects the customer's deferral, so it is not a generic chase.","utterance_ids":["U050","U051"]}]}
